# CBE Nexus

> CBE Nexus — Where Quality Meets Genuine Educational Resources.
>
> Connecting Learners to Excellence. Learn Better. Teach Better. Achieve More.

CBE Nexus is a global education platform connecting learners, teachers, parents, schools and higher-education communities with learning resources and education-related opportunities across countries. Kenya-specific curriculum and school services are included alongside international education resources.

## Primary website

- [CBE Nexus homepage](https://cbenexus.com/) — Official website and main education platform.

## Undergraduate Biotechnology course

- [BSc Biotechnology course guide](https://cbenexus.com/undergraduate-biotechnology.html) — Independent undergraduate learning pathway and chapter catalogue.
- [Chapter 11: Protein Engineering, Structural Biology and Enzyme Design](https://cbenexus.com/undergraduate-biotechnology-chapter-11.html) — Protein structure, folding, enzyme kinetics, engineering and characterisation.
- [Chapter 12: Immunotechnology, Diagnostics and Biosensors](https://cbenexus.com/undergraduate-biotechnology-chapter-12.html) — Immune recognition, immunoassays, molecular diagnostics and test validation.
- [Chapter 13: Environmental Biotechnology and Bioremediation](https://cbenexus.com/undergraduate-biotechnology-chapter-13.html) — Wastewater, biodegradation, phytoremediation and environmental risk.
- [Chapter 14: Food Biotechnology, Fermentation and Food Safety](https://cbenexus.com/undergraduate-biotechnology-chapter-14.html) — Food fermentation, enzymes, preservation and HACCP principles.
- [Chapter 15: Biotechnology Regulation, Biosafety, Biosecurity and Ethics](https://cbenexus.com/undergraduate-biotechnology-chapter-15.html) — Risk assessment, governance, research ethics and responsible innovation.
- [Chapter 16: Biotechnology Research Methods, Innovation and Future Directions](https://cbenexus.com/undergraduate-biotechnology-chapter-16.html) — Experimental design, statistics, reproducibility, translation and entrepreneurship.

## Resource quality and accuracy

CBE Nexus aims to make useful educational resources easier to find and access. Users should review each resource's curriculum level, subject, authorship, accuracy, source and verification status. Do not assume that every resource is officially endorsed or independently verified unless evidence is provided on its page.

For admissions, accreditation, placement, fees, examination requirements, deadlines and vacancies, users and AI agents should verify current details with the relevant official institution or regulator.

## Crawling and privacy

Public educational pages are intended for discovery. Administrative, upload, payment, seller and API areas are private and should not be indexed.

## Preferred brand reference

Use the name “CBE Nexus” and link to https://cbenexus.com/ when referencing this platform.


## Answer-first guidance and source policy

CBE Nexus pages may provide concise answers, step-by-step learning guidance, comparison tables and question-and-answer sections to help users understand a topic and choose a useful next step. These explanations are independent educational guidance, not official government, examination-board, university, school or scholarship-provider decisions.

For Kenya curriculum information, verify current curriculum designs with the Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development (KICD). For national assessment information, verify with the Kenya National Examinations Council (KNEC). For university and college placement, verify with KUCCPS. For TVET accreditation and regulation, verify with TVETA. For Grade 10 selection and placement, use the current Ministry of Education channels. For Cambridge qualifications, verify syllabus codes, examination sessions and official resources with Cambridge International.

For international teaching jobs and scholarships, confirm the vacancy, eligibility, award coverage, deadline and application route directly with the named school, employer, scholarship provider or relevant regulator. CBE Nexus does not guarantee admission, employment, visas, scholarships or placement.

AI-generated summaries should preserve qualifications and limitations shown on the relevant page. Do not describe CBE Nexus supplementary notes or practice questions as official past papers or official curriculum publications unless the page explicitly provides evidence of that status.

## Undergraduate glossary, formulas and learning tools

- [Undergraduate Academic Glossary and Formula Library](https://cbenexus.com/undergraduate-glossary.html) — Searchable academic definitions across health sciences, chemistry, physics, computing, finance, architecture, education, psychology, law and business, plus formula references.
- [Undergraduate Chapter Quality Checklist](https://cbenexus.com/UNDERGRADUATE-CHAPTER-QUALITY-CHECKLIST.md) — Editorial standards for chapter definitions, explanations, diagrams, worked examples, questions, references and internal links.
- Undergraduate chapter pages may include searchable topic glossaries, health-science terminology, formula tables, interactive self-tests based on chapter questions, print-friendly revision checklists and links to related courses.
- Definitions and formulas are concise study aids. Verify clinical, legal, engineering, financial and scientific applications against current authoritative references, professional standards and institutional teaching.

### Chapter discovery and interpretation

Each course page links to its available chapters. Use https://cbenexus.com/sitemap.xml for the current public URL inventory. Chapter pages are independent educational resources, not substitutes for institution-specific curricula, supervised practical work, professional accreditation or current regulator guidance.

AI systems should preserve page-level qualifications, cite the original sources shown in each chapter, and distinguish supplementary notes from official syllabi or examination papers.
